query: What is the single primary outcome and primary target individual (e.g., women of reproductive age, children, household head) and at what follow-up timing will it be measured?

response.query: What is the single primary outcome and primary target individual (e.g., women of reproductive age, children, household head) and at what follow-up timing will it be measured?
response.answer: The primary outcome is the health and wellness of women from adolescence to menopause. The primary target is women of reproductive age, measured at follow-up in October 2025.

results.title: Wellstar Women's Health | Wellstar Health System
results.content: Healthcare provider shares information with a smiling mother-to-be. # Wellstar Women's Health. From adolescence to menopause and beyond, we offer advanced, specialty care tailored to your changing healthcare needs in every stage of life. ### Women's Health at Wellstar. Wellstar women's health experts understand the conditions unique to women in all stages of life. We treat various health issues and life events, from gynecology and pregnancy to fertility and breast health. Wellstar Women's Health understands that every woman is unique, and we know how to empower you to achieve optimal health. Based on your health, our team will help you achieve your goals and craft a plan tailored for you. Whether you need routine prenatal and delivery services or high-risk pregnancy care, we're here to ensure the health and wellness of you and your baby. Our team members collaborate with experts in other medical disciplines throughout Wellstar to provide you with personalized care tailored to your needs.
